The individual is hanging off the edge of the plane with their body extended horizontally, creating a striking visual contrast against the bright yellow of the aircraft. The text overlay at the bottom of the image reads: "Tom Cruise hangs off the side of a plane for his latest daredevil stunt for Mission Impossible.
